descriptionChirho: To act with insolent pride, presumption, or arrogance — behaving with willful defiance against God or proper authority (Exod 18:11; 21:14; Deut 1:43; 17:13; 18:20; Neh 9:10,16,29; Jer 50:29)
To boil or cook by boiling — a distinct homonymous root referring to the physical act of cooking food (Gen 25:29, Jacob boiled pottage)
